description: Percentage of distinct non-null values relative to non-null row count.
sql_query_template:
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT {column})
    / NULLIF(COUNT({column}), 0) AS metric_value,

    0 AS passed_count,
    0 AS failed_count,

    COUNT({column}) AS total_count,
    COUNT({column}) AS applicable_count
FROM {table}

description: Percentage of non-null values satisfying email format.
Percentage of non-null records represented by the top N most frequent values.
sql_query_template:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT
        {column} AS value,
        COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM {table}
    WHERE {column} IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY {column}
),
top_values AS (
    SELECT
        value,
        frequency
    FROM frequencies
    ORDER BY frequency DESC
    LIMIT {top_n}
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(frequency) AS total_frequency
    FROM frequencies
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT SUM(frequency)
            FROM top_values
        ), 0
    ) / NULLIF(
        (SELECT total_frequency FROM totals),
        0
    ) AS metric_value,

    0 AS passed_count,
    0 AS failed_count,

    (SELECT total_frequency FROM totals) AS total_count,

    (SELECT total_frequency FROM totals) AS applicable_count

description: Percentage of child records without a matching parent.
sql_query_template:
SELECT
    100.0 *
    COUNT_IF(p.parent_key IS NULL)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS metric_value,

    COUNT_IF(p.parent_key IS NOT NULL) AS passed_count,

    COUNT_IF(p.parent_key IS NULL) AS failed_count,

    COUNT(*) AS total_count,

    COUNT(*) AS applicable_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        {column} AS child_key
    FROM {table}
    WHERE {column} IS NOT NULL
) c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        {parent_key_column} AS parent_key
    FROM {parent_table}
    WHERE {parent_key_column} IS NOT NULL
) p
ON c.child_key = p.parent_key

child_keys AS (

SELECT

    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS metric_value,

    COUNT_IF(c.child_key IS NOT NULL) AS passed_count,

    COUNT_IF(c.child_key IS NULL) AS failed_count,

    COUNT(*) AS total_count,

    COUNT(*) AS applicable_count
FROM parent_keys p
LEFT JOIN child_keys c
ON p.parent_key = c.child_key

description: Percentage of values matching configured canonical representation.
sql_query_template:
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT_IF(
        CASE
            WHEN {standardization_type} = TRIM
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = TRIM(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {standardization_type} = UPPERCASE
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = UPPER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {standardization_type} = LOWERCASE
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = LOWER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            ELSE FALSE
        END
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT({column}), 0) AS metric_value,

    COUNT_IF(
        CASE
            WHEN {standardization_type} = TRIM
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = TRIM(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {standardization_type} = UPPERCASE
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = UPPER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {standardization_type} = LOWERCASE
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = LOWER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            ELSE FALSE
        END
    ) AS passed_count,

    COUNT_IF(
        NOT (
            CASE
                WHEN {standardization_type} = TRIM
                    THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = TRIM(CAST({column} AS STRING))
                WHEN {standardization_type} = UPPERCASE
                    THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = UPPER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
                WHEN {standardization_type} = LOWERCASE
                    THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = LOWER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
                ELSE FALSE
            END
        )
    ) AS failed_count,

    COUNT({column}) AS total_count,
    COUNT({column}) AS applicable_count
FROM {table}
WHERE {column} IS NOT NULL

description: Percentage of records having a non-null unique primary key.
sql_query_template:
WITH key_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_count,
        COUNT({primary_key_column}) AS non_null_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT {primary_key_column}) AS distinct_count
    FROM {table}
)
SELECT
    100.0 *
    CASE
        WHEN total_count = 0 THEN 100.0
        WHEN non_null_count = total_count
             AND distinct_count = total_count
        THEN 100.0
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS metric_value,

    CASE
        WHEN non_null_count = total_count
             AND distinct_count = total_count
        THEN total_count
        ELSE 0
    END AS passed_count,

    CASE
        WHEN non_null_count = total_count
             AND distinct_count = total_count
        THEN 0
        ELSE total_count
    END AS failed_count,

    total_count,
    total_count AS applicable_count
FROM key_stats

description: Percentage of values following configured case convention.
sql_query_template:
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT_IF(
        CASE
            WHEN {case_convention} = UPPER
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = UPPER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {case_convention} = LOWER
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = LOWER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {case_convention} = MIXED
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT({column}), 0) AS metric_value,

    COUNT_IF(
        CASE
            WHEN {case_convention} = UPPER
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = UPPER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {case_convention} = LOWER
                THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = LOWER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
            WHEN {case_convention} = MIXED
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END
    ) AS passed_count,

    COUNT_IF(
        NOT (
            CASE
                WHEN {case_convention} = UPPER
                    THEN CAST({column} AS STRING) = UPPER(CAST({column} AS STRING))
